jp: 依頼の説明はガベラに任せている。あいつから聞いてくれ。用意した報酬は私が選んだものだからな。痺れるぞ？
jp_grezzo: "依頼の説明はガベラに任せている。あいつから聞いてくれ。用意した報酬は私が選んだものだからな。痺れるぞ？"
en: I'll let Gavela explain the request to you. I'm the one that chose the reward we prepared though. Look forward to it.
en_grezzo: "I'll let Gavela explain the request to you. I'm the one that chose the reward we prepared though. Look forward to it."
it: La richiesta te la spiega Gavela, senti da lui. La ricompensa però l'ho scelta io: vedrai che scossa.

jp: 水を割って決戦兵器が出てきたときは盛り上がったが、発進する度にあれでは手間がかかる。いつまた襲撃されるかもわからない以上、地上で待機させておくしかないだろう。本国の方にはさらに上位のモンスターが多数出現しているらしい。エウダーナやジューアと争う余裕はなさそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "水を割って決戦兵器が出てきたときは盛り上がったが、発進する度にあれでは手間がかかる。いつまた襲撃されるかもわからない以上、地上で待機させておくしかないだろう。本国の方にはさらに上位のモンスターが多数出現しているらしい。エウダーナやジューアと争う余裕はなさそうだ。"
en: It was exciting when our decisive weapon came out and turned the tide of the battle, but it takes a long time to prepare. Since we could be attacked at any time, I have to keep the soldiers on high alert. From our reports, stronger monsters have been appearing closer to the capital as well. We're under enough pressure that fighting with the Juere or Eulderna is impossible.
en_grezzo: "It was exciting when our decisive weapon came out and turned the tide of the battle, but it takes a long time to prepare. Since we could be attacked at any time, I have to keep the soldiers on high alert. From our reports, stronger monsters have been appearing closer to the capital as well. We're under enough pressure that fighting with the Juere or Eulderna is impossible."
it: È stato un bel momento, quando l'arma della battaglia decisiva è emersa spaccando le acque; ma ogni volta che deve partire ci vuole un'eternità. Finché non sappiamo quando arriverà il prossimo attacco, non resta che tenerla a terra. Pare che verso la capitale stiano comparendo mostri anche più forti: non abbiamo il fiato per metterci a litigare con Eulderna o con Juere.

jp: 汚染・同化される可能性を考えると、やはり奴に生身で挑むのは得策ではない。イェルスード２号機の完成を急がせるか…。
jp_grezzo: "汚染・同化される可能性を考えると、やはり奴に生身で挑むのは得策ではない。イェルスード２号機の完成を急がせるか…。"
en: Given the likelihood of being contaminated or absorbed, facing that monster with live soldiers probably isn't a good idea. We need to hurry up and complete the Yerleswood MK II...
en_grezzo: "Given the likelihood of being contaminated or absorbed, facing that monster with live soldiers probably isn't a good idea. We need to hurry up and complete the Yerleswood MK II..."
it: Col rischio di essere contaminati o assimilati, mandargli contro uomini in carne e ossa non è una buona idea. Bisogna accelerare i lavori sullo Yerleswood Mk II...

jp: 調査部隊は遺跡最深部へ向かっている。追いついて護衛に加わってくれ。私たちの部隊も後から行く予定だ。
jp_grezzo: "調査部隊は遺跡最深部へ向かっている。追いついて護衛に加わってくれ。私たちの部隊も後から行く予定だ。"
en: The investigation team is heading for the deepest part of the ruins. Catch up to them and protect them from harm. A military unit will be sent behind you shortly.
en_grezzo: "The investigation team is heading for the deepest part of the ruins. Catch up to them and protect them from harm. A military unit will be sent behind you shortly."
it: La squadra d'indagine sta scendendo verso il fondo delle rovine. Raggiungila e mettiti di scorta. Anche il nostro reparto partirà a breve.

jp: 何？レミード遺跡に入りたいだと。…ふむ、腕はたちそうだな。調査部隊の護衛を引き受けてくれるのなら考えてやらんでもない。
jp_grezzo: "何？レミード遺跡に入りたいだと。…ふむ、腕はたちそうだな。調査部隊の護衛を引き受けてくれるのなら考えてやらんでもない。"
en: What's that? You want to enter Remido? Hmm... Well, you seem to have the skill for it. I'll consider it if you agree to serve as a bodyguard for the investigation unit.
en_grezzo: "What's that? You want to enter Remido? Hmm... Well, you seem to have the skill for it. I'll consider it if you agree to serve as a bodyguard for the investigation unit."
it: Come? Vuoi entrare a Remido? Uhm... sembri in gamba, però. Se ti prendi la scorta della squadra d'indagine, posso pensarci.

jp: 酒場の隣のラボにガベラという白衣を着た男がいる。護衛をする気があるなら通行用のカードキーをそいつに作ってもらいたまえ。ただあいつは変わり者だ…上手く交渉するんだな。
jp_grezzo: "酒場の隣のラボにガベラという白衣を着た男がいる。護衛をする気があるなら通行用のカードキーをそいつに作ってもらいたまえ。ただあいつは変わり者だ…上手く交渉するんだな。"
en: There is a man by the name of Gavela in the laboratory next to the bar. If you decide to serve as a bodyguard, have him make you a card key. He's an odd one though... You may have to negotiate.
en_grezzo: "There is a man by the name of Gavela in the laboratory next to the bar. If you decide to serve as a bodyguard, have him make you a card key. He's an odd one though... You may have to negotiate."
it: Nel laboratorio accanto alla taverna c'è un uomo in camice bianco, Gavela. Se fai da scorta, fatti fare da lui la tessera per il passaggio. È un tipo strano, però: dovrai saperci fare.

jp: 見ろ、このパワーアームを。痺れるだろう？イェルスの科学力は世界一だ。
jp_grezzo: "見ろ、このパワーアームを。痺れるだろう？イェルスの科学力は世界一だ。"
en: Feast your eyes on this power arm. Amazed? Yerles has the best scientists in the world.
en_grezzo: "Feast your eyes on this power arm. Amazed? Yerles has the best scientists in the world."
it: Guarda qua, questo braccio meccanico. Fa impressione, eh? La scienza di Yerles non ha rivali.

jp: 船酔いでダウンするなんてまだまだ俺様も修行が足りねぇな…。
jp_grezzo: "船酔いでダウンするなんてまだまだ俺様も修行が足りねぇな…。"
en: Getting seasick like that... Seems like I still need more training...
en_grezzo: "Getting seasick like that... Seems like I still need more training..."
it: Farmi stendere dal mal di mare... si vede che devo ancora allenarmi.

jp: お、じゃねぇか。お前最近この辺で有名になってきてるな。
jp_grezzo: "お、" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + "じゃねぇか。お前最近この辺で有名になってきてるな。"
en: Oh, you're  aren't you? I've been hearing about you a lot recently.
en_grezzo: "Oh, you're " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " aren't you? I've been hearing about you a lot recently."
contesto: chatMore lang("お、" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + "じゃねぇか。お前最近この辺で有名になってきてるな。", "Oh, you're " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " aren't you? I've been hearing about you a lot recently.")
it: "Oh, ma tu sei " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Da queste parti si comincia a parlare parecchio di te."

jp: その話乗った！
jp_grezzo: "その話乗った！"
en: Let's do it!
en_grezzo: "Let's do it!"
it: Ci sto!

jp: 船はトラウマだ
jp_grezzo: "船はトラウマだ"
en: I haven't had good experiences with ships.
en_grezzo: "I haven't had good experiences with ships."
it: Le navi mi fanno venire i brividi

jp: そうだ、俺様と海賊狩りに行かねぇか？この辺の海には海賊がうじゃうじゃ出るってんで、船を借りて海賊のお宝強奪に行こうと思ってよ。船代は俺様が出すからお宝の取り分は俺様が7、お前が3だ。
jp_grezzo: "そうだ、俺様と海賊狩りに行かねぇか？この辺の海には海賊がうじゃうじゃ出るってんで、船を借りて海賊のお宝強奪に行こうと思ってよ。船代は俺様が出すからお宝の取り分は俺様が7、お前が3だ。"
en: I know, why don't you come pirate hunting with me? Pirates have been hanging around this area lately, so I'm going to take their treasure. I'll take 70% of the spoils to cover the boat fee, but you can have the other 30%.
en_grezzo: "I know, why don't you come pirate hunting with me? Pirates have been hanging around this area lately, so I'm going to take their treasure. I'll take 70% of the spoils to cover the boat fee, but you can have the other 30%."
it: Ecco: che ne dici di venire a caccia di pirati con me? Da queste parti i pirati brulicano, e io ho intenzione di prendere una barca e andare a fregargli il tesoro. La barca la pago io, quindi del bottino sette a me e tre a te.

jp: なんだ？前に乗ってた船が沈没でもしたのか？
jp_grezzo: "なんだ？前に乗ってた船が沈没でもしたのか？"
en: Huh? Did the ship you rode on before sink too?
en_grezzo: "Huh? Did the ship you rode on before sink too?"
it: Come? Ti è affondata sotto anche l'ultima?

jp: じゃあ早速行くか！俺様とお前で海賊どもを蹴散らしてやろうぜ。
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ早速行くか！俺様とお前で海賊どもを蹴散らしてやろうぜ。"
en: Let's go then! We'll kick some pirate ass.
en_grezzo: "Let's go then! We'll kick some pirate ass."
it: E allora andiamo! Io e te li spazziamo via, quei pirati.

jp: 狩りに戻ろう
jp_grezzo: "狩りに戻ろう"
en: Let's get back to hunting pirates.
en_grezzo: "Let's get back to hunting pirates."
it: Torniamo a caccia

jp: 大丈夫？
jp_grezzo: "大丈夫？"
en: Are you okay?
en_grezzo: "Are you okay?"
it: Tutto bene?

jp: う、うっぷ…。船、揺れすぎだろ…。
jp_grezzo: "う、うっぷ…。船、揺れすぎだろ…。"
en: U-ugh... The ship is rocking too much...
en_grezzo: "U-ugh... The ship is rocking too much..."
it: U-urgh... ma quanto beccheggia, questa barca...

jp: も、問題ない。でも、もう少し休んでいこうぜ…。
jp_grezzo: "も、問題ない。でも、もう少し休んでいこうぜ…。"
en: I-I'm fine. But let me rest for just a while longer...
en_grezzo: "I-I'm fine. But let me rest for just a while longer..."
it: N-nessun problema. Però fammi riposare ancora un po'...

jp: あ…あ…？そ、そうだな…。
jp_grezzo: "あ…あ…？そ、そうだな…。"
en: H...Huh...? Ah, t-that's right...
en_grezzo: "H...Huh...? Ah, t-that's right..."
it: Ah... ah...? G-giusto...

jp: う…何、海賊のボス討ち取ってきたって？そりゃすげぇ…うっぷ。お前は船酔いしなかったのか？俺様はずっと甲板でダウンしてたぜ…。あ？宝？そんなもんどうでもいいから背中さすってくれよ…。
jp_grezzo: "う…何、海賊のボス討ち取ってきたって？そりゃすげぇ…うっぷ。お前は船酔いしなかったのか？俺様はずっと甲板でダウンしてたぜ…。あ？宝？そんなもんどうでもいいから背中さすってくれよ…。"
en: Uugh... Y-You defeated the pirate boss? That's incredible... ugh. How did you not get seasick? I was sick the whole time... Huh? Treasure? I don't care about that, just rub my back for me...
en_grezzo: "Uugh... Y-You defeated the pirate boss? That's incredible... ugh. How did you not get seasick? I was sick the whole time... Huh? Treasure? I don't care about that, just rub my back for me..."
it: Urgh... come, hai abbattuto il capo dei pirati? Roba da matti... Ma tu il mal di mare non ce l'hai? Io sono rimasto steso in coperta tutto il tempo... Eh? Il tesoro? Chi se ne importa, strofinami la schiena...

jp: 近年、迷子になる子猫が急増しているのであります！もし迷子の子猫を見かけましたら、本官のところまで送り届けて欲しいであります！何も報酬は出せませんが…子猫たちとそのご家族のためにも、どうかよろしくお願いなのです！
jp_grezzo: "近年、迷子になる子猫が急増しているのであります！もし迷子の子猫を見かけましたら、本官のところまで送り届けて欲しいであります！何も報酬は出せませんが…子猫たちとそのご家族のためにも、どうかよろしくお願いなのです！"
en: The number of kittens who become lost has increased in recent years. If you find any stray cats, please bring them to me! I can't offer you a reward, but... I'm certain the kittens and their families would be very thankful for your help!
en_grezzo: "The number of kittens who become lost has increased in recent years. If you find any stray cats, please bring them to me! I can't offer you a reward, but... I'm certain the kittens and their families would be very thankful for your help!"
it: Negli ultimi anni i gattini che si perdono sono aumentati a vista d'occhio! Se ne vedi uno smarrito, portalo qui da me, bau! Ricompense non ne posso dare... ma per i gattini e per le loro famiglie, ti chiedo di darci una mano!

jp: 頭をなでる
jp_grezzo: "頭をなでる"
en: Pat his head.
en_grezzo: "Pat his head."
it: Accarezzargli la testa

jp: 迷子の子猫を引き渡す
jp_grezzo: "迷子の子猫を引き渡す"
en: (Turn over the stray kitten.)
en_grezzo: "(Turn over the stray kitten.)"
it: (Consegnare il gattino smarrito)

jp: 子猫のご両親も心配しておられます！早く見つけ出して安心させてあげたいでありますよ…。
jp_grezzo: "子猫のご両親も心配しておられます！早く見つけ出して安心させてあげたいでありますよ…。"
en: The parents of the stray kittens are very concerned! I hope we can bring them some relief soon...
en_grezzo: "The parents of the stray kittens are very concerned! I hope we can bring them some relief soon..."
it: Anche i genitori dei gattini sono in pena! Vorrei trovarli presto e togliergli il pensiero...

jp: わふっ？
jp_grezzo: "わふっ？"
en: Woof?
en_grezzo: "Woof?"
it: Bau?

jp: それは成長が足りていない。
jp_grezzo: "それは成長が足りていない。"
en: It has not grown enough.
en_grezzo: "It has not grown enough."
it: Deve ancora crescere.

jp: 迷子の子猫を犬のおまわりさんに引き渡した。「おうちかえれう？」
jp_grezzo: "迷子の子猫を犬のおまわりさんに引き渡した。「おうちかえれう？」"
en: You turned over the stray cat to the dog cop. Am I going home?
en_grezzo: "You turned over the stray cat to the dog cop. " + cnvtalk("Am I going home?")
contesto: txt lang("迷子の子猫を犬のおまわりさんに引き渡した。「おうちかえれう？」", "You turned over the stray cat to the dog cop. " + cnvtalk("Am I going home?"))
it: "Consegni il gattino smarrito al Cane poliziotto. " + cnvtalk("Torno a casetta?")

jp: この子は…捜索願の出ていた子猫であります！本官が責任を持って親元に帰しましょう。ご協力感謝であります！他にも迷子は大勢いますので、見つけたらまた連れてきてください！
jp_grezzo: "この子は…捜索願の出ていた子猫であります！本官が責任を持って親元に帰しましょう。ご協力感謝であります！他にも迷子は大勢いますので、見つけたらまた連れてきてください！"
en: This kitten... yes, it's one of the ones that was reported missing! I will make sure that it reaches its parents safely. Thank you for your help! If you find any other lost kittens, please bring them to me!
en_grezzo: "This kitten... yes, it's one of the ones that was reported missing! I will make sure that it reaches its parents safely. Thank you for your help! If you find any other lost kittens, please bring them to me!"
it: Questo cucciolo... sì, è uno di quelli segnalati come scomparsi! Lo riporterò ai suoi genitori, ne rispondo io. Grazie della collaborazione, bau! Ce ne sono ancora tanti smarriti: se ne trovi altri, portameli!

jp: 貴方のように優秀な戦士は嫌いではありません。今度わが軍の入隊試験を受けてみませんか？貴方と共に戦える日を楽しみにしています。
jp_grezzo: "貴方のように優秀な戦士は嫌いではありません。今度わが軍の入隊試験を受けてみませんか？貴方と共に戦える日を楽しみにしています。"
en: I like strong warriors like you. Care to take the military enlistment test? I'm looking forward to getting to fight alongside you.
en_grezzo: "I like strong warriors like you. Care to take the military enlistment test? I'm looking forward to getting to fight alongside you."
it: I guerrieri in gamba come te non mi dispiacciono. Perché non provi l'esame di arruolamento da noi? Aspetto il giorno in cui combatteremo insieme.

jp: 自分はイェルス軍第７特殊部隊の隊長、ミーリスです！冒険者である貴方に我々の作戦に参加していただきたいのです。
jp_grezzo: "自分はイェルス軍第７特殊部隊の隊長、ミーリスです！冒険者である貴方に我々の作戦に参加していただきたいのです。"
en: I am Milis, captain of the Yerles 7th Special Forces division! I'm looking for an adventurer like yourself to participate in our operation.
en_grezzo: "I am Milis, captain of the Yerles 7th Special Forces division! I'm looking for an adventurer like yourself to participate in our operation."
it: Sono Milis, capitano della settima unità speciale dell'esercito di Yerles! Cerco qualcuno che vada all'avventura, come te, per prendere parte a un'operazione.

jp: 了解です
jp_grezzo: "了解です"
en: Sure.
en_grezzo: "Sure."
it: D'accordo

jp: やめておきます
jp_grezzo: "やめておきます"
en: I'll pass.
en_grezzo: "I'll pass."
it: Passo

jp: 現在、我々が調査している遺跡をエウダーナも狙っています。任務遂行のためにエウダーナの補給ルートを潰したいのですが、この近くに駐留しているエウダーナの部隊が邪魔なのです。そちらに割くだけの戦力はありません。敵部隊を攻撃して注意を惹きつけていただけないでしょうか？当然、報酬は支払います。
jp_grezzo: "現在、我々が調査している遺跡をエウダーナも狙っています。任務遂行のためにエウダーナの補給ルートを潰したいのですが、この近くに駐留しているエウダーナの部隊が邪魔なのです。そちらに割くだけの戦力はありません。敵部隊を攻撃して注意を惹きつけていただけないでしょうか？当然、報酬は支払います。"
en: The Eulderna are also aiming at the ruins that we are currently investigating. I'd like to cut off their supply route, but the soldiers they have stationed nearby are in the way. I don't have enough troops to take care of both the supply route and their soldiers. Could you distract them for us? You'll be rewarded, of course.
en_grezzo: "The Eulderna are also aiming at the ruins that we are currently investigating. I'd like to cut off their supply route, but the soldiers they have stationed nearby are in the way. I don't have enough troops to take care of both the supply route and their soldiers. Could you distract them for us? You'll be rewarded, of course."
it: Le rovine che stiamo esplorando fanno gola anche a Eulderna. Vorrei tagliare la loro linea di rifornimento, ma il reparto che hanno di stanza qui vicino è d'intralcio, e di truppe non ne ho abbastanza per occuparmi di tutt'e due le cose. Potresti attirare tu la loro attenzione? La ricompensa, naturalmente, ci sarà.

jp: 残念です…もしお気持ちが変わりましたら、またおいでください。
jp_grezzo: "残念です…もしお気持ちが変わりましたら、またおいでください。"
en: That's too bad... If you change your mind, please come talk to me again.
en_grezzo: "That's too bad... If you change your mind, please come talk to me again."
it: Peccato... Se dovessi cambiare idea, torna pure a parlarmi.

jp: 引き受けていただいたこと、感謝します。準備ができたら、声をかけてください。部下が作戦領域まで案内します。
jp_grezzo: "引き受けていただいたこと、感謝します。準備ができたら、声をかけてください。部下が作戦領域まで案内します。"
en: I appreciate your cooperation. Let me know when you're ready. My subordinates will guide you to the area.
en_grezzo: "I appreciate your cooperation. Let me know when you're ready. My subordinates will guide you to the area."
it: Ti ringrazio di aver accettato. Quando sei in ordine fammi un cenno: ti accompagneranno i miei uomini.

jp: 問題ありません
jp_grezzo: "問題ありません"
en: Yes.
en_grezzo: "Yes."
it: Nessun problema

jp: 用事を思い出した
jp_grezzo: "用事を思い出した"
en: I have something else to do first.
en_grezzo: "I have something else to do first."
it: Mi è venuta in mente una cosa

jp: しばらくの間、彼らの注意を惹きつけておいてください。準備はよろしいですか？
jp_grezzo: "しばらくの間、彼らの注意を惹きつけておいてください。準備はよろしいですか？"
en: All you need to do is distract them for a while. Have you made your preparations?
en_grezzo: "All you need to do is distract them for a while. Have you made your preparations?"
it: Basta che li tenga occupati per un po'. I preparativi sono a posto?

jp: 急いでくださいね。
jp_grezzo: "急いでくださいね。"
en: Please take care of it quickly.
en_grezzo: "Please take care of it quickly."
it: Fai presto, mi raccomando.

jp: 敵部隊の中には魔法で支配されたわが軍の兵士もいるようです。一思いに楽にしてあげてください。…生きて、またここで会いましょう。では…作戦開始！
jp_grezzo: "敵部隊の中には魔法で支配されたわが軍の兵士もいるようです。一思いに楽にしてあげてください。…生きて、またここで会いましょう。では…作戦開始！"
en: Some of the enemy troops seem to have ensorcelled some of our own men with magic. Do not hesitate to fight them. And... make sure to live so we can meet again. Now then... Operation start!
en_grezzo: "Some of the enemy troops seem to have ensorcelled some of our own men with magic. Do not hesitate to fight them. And... make sure to live so we can meet again. Now then... Operation start!"
it: Pare che fra le truppe nemiche ci siano anche nostri soldati soggiogati con la magia. Non esitare: liberali in fretta. E... torna indietro, così ci rivediamo qui. E adesso... operazione avviata!

jp: 貴方のおかげでこちらの作戦も無事完了しました…え？陽動するだけでなく殲滅まで？こちらで処理をするつもりでしたが手間が省けました。ではその分、報酬の上乗せをしておきますね。
jp_grezzo: "貴方のおかげでこちらの作戦も無事完了しました…え？陽動するだけでなく殲滅まで？こちらで処理をするつもりでしたが手間が省けました。ではその分、報酬の上乗せをしておきますね。"
en: Our plan succeeded thanks to your help... huh? You eliminated them rather than just distracting them? You've saved us the trouble of handling them ourselves. I'll increase your reward then.
en_grezzo: "Our plan succeeded thanks to your help... huh? You eliminated them rather than just distracting them? You've saved us the trouble of handling them ourselves. I'll increase your reward then."
it: Grazie a te anche la nostra operazione è andata a buon fine... Come? Non li hai solo distratti, li hai sterminati? Ci hai risparmiato la fatica di farlo noi. E allora la ricompensa la aumento.

jp: 断るのはしょうがないけど、今聞いたことはバラすなよ！
jp_grezzo: "断るのはしょうがないけど、今聞いたことはバラすなよ！"
en: That's fine, but don't tell everyone what I just told you!
en_grezzo: "That's fine, but don't tell everyone what I just told you!"
it: Va bene, ma quel che ti ho appena detto non andarlo a raccontare in giro!

jp: た、助かったァー！！地下通路への階段出しとくからすぐに行ってきてくれ！
jp_grezzo: "た、助かったァー！！地下通路への階段出しとくからすぐに行ってきてくれ！"
en: I-I'm saved...! I'll show you the stairs to the underground passage. Please take care of them as soon as possible!
en_grezzo: "I-I'm saved...! I'll show you the stairs to the underground passage. Please take care of them as soon as possible!"
it: M-mi hai salvato...! Ti apro le scale che scendono al passaggio sotterraneo: vacci subito, ti prego!

jp: なんか地下がうるさい、とか言うやつ出てきちゃったよ！早く殲滅してきてくれ！
jp_grezzo: "なんか地下がうるさい、とか言うやつ出てきちゃったよ！早く殲滅してきてくれ！"
en: People keep talking about hearing noises coming from the underground passage! Please, take care of the intruders quickly!
en_grezzo: "People keep talking about hearing noises coming from the underground passage! Please, take care of the intruders quickly!"
it: C'è già chi va in giro a dire che dal sottosuolo si sentono rumori! Sbrigati a sterminarli!

jp: うへぇ、ギリギリセーフだ。危ないところだった…。こいつはお礼さ、受け取ってくれ。なんか地下倉庫の隅で埃かぶってた欠陥装備だけど、そこそこ高性能なはずだ。多分。
jp_grezzo: "うへぇ、ギリギリセーフだ。危ないところだった…。こいつはお礼さ、受け取ってくれ。なんか地下倉庫の隅で埃かぶってた欠陥装備だけど、そこそこ高性能なはずだ。多分。"
en: Whew, we barely made it. That was close... Here, take this as my thanks. It's defective gear we had laying around in the warehouse underground. It should have pretty high performance. Probably.
en_grezzo: "Whew, we barely made it. That was close... Here, take this as my thanks. It's defective gear we had laying around in the warehouse underground. It should have pretty high performance. Probably."
it: Uff, ce l'abbiamo fatta per un pelo. C'è mancato poco... Tieni, come ringraziamento. È equipaggiamento difettoso che prendeva polvere nel magazzino sotterraneo, ma dovrebbe rendere. Credo.
